## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squashed commit).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) pass.
- [ ] The red lines in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) hold: no secret or attribute value stored, read-only, no network call to a backend the user did not name.
- [ ] Docs are updated where behaviour, flags or the snapshot format changed.
- [ ] I have read and signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the CLA check asks on a first pull request).
